purpose: Separate V21/V14 representation loss, selected-donor population mismatch, cross-condition inverse inflation, and deterministic/2PCF limitations after the failed V28 empirical control.

diagnostics.representation_self_reconstruction: invert each frozen validation V21 latent through V21 and V14 with its own mean and location/scales, then compare with its own held-out physical target
diagnostics.selected_donor_population: compare the physical train truths of the exact selected V28 donors with the corresponding validation truths; no new donor search
diagnostics.cross_condition_transfer: compare stored V28 cross-inverted samples with those exact selected donors' own physical train truths
diagnostics.source_decomposition: repeat donor and cross-inverted marginal summaries by TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift donor source
diagnostics.distance_tail_association: record Spearman correlation of frozen total matching distance with generated physical maximum; diagnostic only
diagnostics.backbone_and_2pcf: copy deterministic-versus-truth and generated-versus-truth 2PCF KS by scale from the frozen metrics

fixed_classification_order.condition: representation self-reconstruction fails any unchanged physical check
fixed_classification_order.next: repair and validate a lossless physical-density coordinate before another residual model

fixed_classification_order.condition: self-reconstruction passes but cross-condition transfer relative to selected donor truths fails
fixed_classification_order.next: replace latent transplantation with a condition-consistent physical residual representation

fixed_classification_order.condition: self and cross transfer pass but selected donor truths fail against validation truths
fixed_classification_order.next: redesign the local observation descriptor and deterministic current-density backbone

fixed_classification_order.condition: physical checks pass but 2PCF still fails
fixed_classification_order.next: audit and replace the deterministic current-density backbone before residual modeling
